schema:name: CommunityHealthWorker
dcterms:title: Community health worker
dcterms:description:
Community health workers provide health education, referral and follow-up, case management and basic preventive health care and home visiting services to specific communities. They provide support and assistance to clients by reminding them to get their vaccinations, responding to emergencies and reporting births.

**Alternate names**: Community health volunteer, village health worker, volunteer assistant, volunteer health worker, treatment supporter, health promoter.

**ISCO-08**: 3253 Worker, community: health.

A targeted generic persona of the WHO Digital Adaptation Kit for Immunizations.
